query: Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station highest daily maximum temperature recorded so far July 2026, actual observations July 7-13 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

## Answer

The **highest daily maximum temperature recorded at the Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station so far in July 2026 was 119°F (48.3°C)**, reached on **three consecutive days: July 9, 10, and 11, 2026**. This peak falls within the July 7–13 window you asked about.

**Actual daily maximum observations, July 7–13, 2026 (DEVC1):**
| Date | Daily Max |
|------|-----------|
| Jul 7 | 117°F |
| Jul 8 | 117°F |
| **Jul 9** | **119°F** ← peak |
| **Jul 10** | **119°F** ← peak |
| **Jul 11** | **119°F** ← peak |
| Jul 12 | 113°F |
| Jul 13 | 109°F |

The heat wave built from 114°F (Jul 6) to a 119°F plateau (Jul 9–11), then receded to 109°F by Jul 13 and 103°F on Jul 14 (partial).

**Context:** 119°F is roughly at/slightly above Death Valley's July climatological average high (~116°F) but well below the station's modern records (130.0°F on July 9, 2021; 129.9°F on Aug 16, 2020) and the all-time world record of 134°F (July 10, 1913). Recent-year July annual maxima have typically hit 125–130°F.

**Data source:** Iowa Environmental Mesonet daily summaries derived from the DEVC1 feed (network CA_DCP). DEVC1 is not an ASOS/METAR station; values may differ ±1°F from the official NWS Las Vegas CLI/F6 climate reports, which are the definitive certifying source. The July 14 value is preliminary.
